                                                      DOCKET NO. 59611


 APPLICATION OF EL PASO                                                 §   PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION
 ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR APROVAL                                           §
 OF A HIGH LOAD FACTOR LARGE                                            §           OF TEXAS
 POWER SERVICE TARIFF                                                   §


                            ORDER NO. 2
   REQUIRING COMMENTS AND RECOMMENDATIONS ON THE APPLICATION,
  PROPOSED NOTICE, AND APPROPRIATE PROCESSING OF THE APPLICATION

          In Order No. 1 filed on April 8, 2026, the Administrative Law Judge established a deadline
of April 22, 2026 for Commission Staff to file comments and recommendations on the
administrative completeness of El Paso Electric Company’s April 7, 2026 application for approval
of a new tariff applicable to very large, high load factor customers. To date, Commission Staff
has not filed its recommendation in this docket.

          By April 29, 2026, Commission Staff must file its comments and recommendations on the
administrative completeness of the application and notice, and a proposal, including procedural
schedule, for the appropriate processing of this docket.

          Signed at Austin, Texas, on the 24th day of April 2026.
                                                                 PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS




                                                                 ERIC YOON
                                                                 ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGE
